sentences.en: I think that that is evoking some of the emotion and images we saw in the last month, that through a kind of historic assault on our democracy that was based in that bitterness.
sentences.zh: 我认为这唤起了我们在过去一个月里看到的一些情绪和画面，即通过一种基于这种痛苦的、对我们民主的历史性攻击。

sentences.en: He's saying, let's choose a different path.
sentences.zh: 他是在说，让我们选择一条不同的道路。

sentences.en: And that to do so, we all have to choose to be better to one another.
sentences.zh: 而要做到这一点，我们都必须选择对彼此更好。

sentences.en: We must end this uncivil war that pits red against blue, rural versus urban, conservative versus liberal.
sentences.zh: 我们必须结束这场让红蓝阵营、城乡之间、保守派与自由派对立的非文明战争。

sentences.en: We can do this if we open our souls instead of hardening our hearts, if we show a little tolerance and humility, and if we're willing to stand in the other person's shoes,
sentences.zh: 如果我们敞开心扉而不是变得铁石心肠，如果我们表现出一点宽容和谦逊，如果我们愿意站在别人的立场上，我们就能做到这一点，

sentences.en: as my mom would say, just for a moment, stand in their shoes.
sentences.zh: 正如我妈妈常说的，哪怕只是片刻，站在他们的立场上想一想。

sentences.en: It feels like this was not so much an inauguration speech as a kind of sermon, right?
sentences.zh: 感觉这与其说是一场就职演说，不如说是一场布道，对吧？

sentences.en: A sermon to an angry and divided country.
sentences.zh: 一场对一个愤怒且分裂的国家的布道。

sentences.en: There's not a single reference to a policy in this speech, right?
sentences.zh: 这篇演讲中没有提到任何具体的政策，对吧？

sentences.en: It's not about an agenda.
sentences.zh: 这不是关于议程的。

sentences.en: It is a kind of wartime message to a profoundly polarized America.
sentences.zh: 这是一种针对极度两极分化的美国的战时信息。

sentences.en: I thought that also, you know, I got flashbacks to my father, who's a pastor, and can sometimes copy and paste some of the portions of this speech.
sentences.zh: 我也这么认为，你知道，我想起了我的父亲，他是一位牧师，有时可以直接照搬这篇演讲中的部分内容。

sentences.en: I mean, you really have someone who, to be honest, did not run that clearly on policy, obviously had them, could reference them.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你面对的确实是一个坦白说并没有明确以政策为竞选纲领的人，他显然有政策，也能引用它们。

sentences.en: But why Joe Biden is the president today is because Americans, enough Americans, really believed that the priority for this moment was not policy,
sentences.zh: 但乔·拜登今天之所以成为总统，是因为美国人，足够多的美国人，真的相信这一刻的优先事项不是政策，

sentences.en: was not a kind of rethinking of Americans' institutions, but a kind of ridding of Trump and Trumpism with the exact opposite.
sentences.zh: 不是对美国制度的某种反思，而是以完全相反的方式摆脱特朗普和特朗普主义。

sentences.en: And what he is pitching here, and who Joe Biden is, has been a kind of sermon-esque, pastor-esque speaker,
sentences.zh: 他在这里所推崇的，以及乔·拜登本人，一直是一位布道式、牧师式的演讲者，

sentences.en: who is someone who would talk about these themes and comfort a nation in times of conflict.
sentences.zh: 他是一个会谈论这些主题并在冲突时期安慰国家的人。

sentences.en: And I think this is the biggest moment yet, from the virus, from racial inequity, from an assault on democracy.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是迄今为止最大的时刻，无论是病毒、种族不平等，还是对民主的攻击。

sentences.en: He is going back to that toolbox to say, it might seem even more bleak right now, but the same things that got us out previously will get us out again.
sentences.zh: 他正在回到那个工具箱，想说，现在看起来可能更加黯淡，但以前让我们走出困境的同样的东西，这次也会让我们再次走出来。

sentences.en: Together, we shall write an American story of hope, not fear, of unity, not division, of light, not darkness, a story of decency and dignity, love and healing,
sentences.zh: 我们将共同书写一个关于希望而非恐惧、团结而非分裂、光明而非黑暗的美国故事，一个关于体面与尊严、爱与治愈的故事，

sentences.en: greatness and goodness.
sentences.zh: 伟大与善良的故事。

sentences.en: May this be the story that guides us, the story that inspires us, and the story that tells ages yet to come, that we answer the call of history, we met the moment,
sentences.zh: 愿这成为指引我们的故事，激励我们的故事，并告诉后世的故事：我们响应了历史的召唤，我们迎接了这一时刻，

sentences.en: democracy and hope, truth and justice, did not die on our watch, but thrived.
sentences.zh: 民主与希望、真理与正义，没有在我们手中消亡，而是蓬勃发展。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了吗？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你能免费试用《时报》一个月，而且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall, to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间越过付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: As I said, we've been talking about the content of this speech.
sentences.zh: 正如我所说，我们一直在讨论这篇演讲的内容。

sentences.en: I also want to talk about what was not in this speech, because what was not in this speech feels important.
sentences.zh: 我还想谈谈这篇演讲中没有提到的内容，因为没有提到的内容感觉很重要。

sentences.en: For example, Joe Biden describes what must be overcome to create unity.
sentences.zh: 例如，乔·拜登描述了为了实现团结必须克服什么。

sentences.en: And you just described some of it.
sentences.zh: 而你刚刚描述了其中的一部分。

sentences.en: Lies, violence, darkness, racism, extremism, white supremacy.
sentences.zh: 谎言、暴力、黑暗、种族主义、极端主义、白人至上主义。

sentences.en: But Joe Biden does not, in this inaugural speech, identify who spoke those lies or who harbored those forms of hate or perpetrated those acts of violence.
sentences.zh: 但乔·拜登在这篇就职演说中并没有指明是谁说了这些谎言，是谁怀有这些仇恨，或是谁犯下了这些暴力行为。

sentences.en: He names problems, but does not name actors.
sentences.zh: 他指出了问题，但没有指名道姓。

sentences.en: Why do you think that was?
sentences.zh: 你认为这是为什么？

sentences.en: It is a hint to how he defines unity.
sentences.zh: 这是他如何定义团结的一个暗示。

sentences.en: Unity can come through accountability, can come through justice, but those are steps that have concrete actions attached to it.
sentences.zh: 团结可以通过问责制实现，可以通过正义实现，但这些步骤需要具体的行动来支撑。

sentences.en: We have not heard, really, that from Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 我们并没有真正从乔·拜登那里听到这些。

sentences.en: What we have largely heard is a sense of personal absolution, a sense of personal growth that is a moral mission,
sentences.zh: 我们听到的大多是一种个人的赦免感，一种作为道德使命的个人成长感，

sentences.en: but does not necessarily kind of corral the country in a kind of movement-esque way.
sentences.zh: 但这并不一定能以某种运动的方式将国家凝聚起来。

sentences.en: And I don't think that that is surprising.
sentences.zh: 我不认为这令人惊讶。

sentences.en: Why do you think he chose not to do that?
sentences.zh: 你认为他为什么选择不这样做？

sentences.en: And what does it tell us?
sentences.zh: 这告诉了我们什么？

sentences.en: I think that this is an attempt to turn the page.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一种翻开新篇章的尝试。

sentences.en: He does not speak Trump's name.
sentences.zh: 他没有提到特朗普的名字。

sentences.en: He does not talk specifically about some of the biggest grievances of the Trump era.
sentences.zh: 他没有具体谈论特朗普时代的一些最大不满。

sentences.en: But he is trying to kick off a new one that is defined by the values he holds dear.
sentences.zh: 但他正试图开启一个由他珍视的价值观所定义的新时代。

sentences.en: So it is an attempt by Joe Biden to move on and to set a new tone without the dealing with the root causes that allow that to fester.
sentences.zh: 所以这是乔·拜登试图继续前进并设定新基调的尝试，而没有处理导致这些问题恶化的根本原因。

sentences.en: That is going to be the big challenge from him, is can you tackle those big goals like racism, extremism, misinformation, and the like,
sentences.zh: 这将是他面临的最大挑战，即你是否能在不让人们感到不舒服的情况下，去解决像种族主义、极端主义、错误信息等这样的大目标，对吧？

sentences.en: without a real comfort in making people uncomfortable, right?
sentences.zh: 你能在不让几个人生气的情况下，处理这个国家原罪和最初的挑战吗？

sentences.en: Can you deal with kind of the nation's original sin and original challenges without, frankly, making a few people mad?
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，你能在不让几个人生气的情况下处理这个国家的原罪和最初的挑战吗？

sentences.en: And which one of those goals will really be the governing priority for him going forward?
sentences.zh: 在未来的日子里，这些目标中哪一个将真正成为他的执政重点？

sentences.en: Will it be that sense of civility and unity and lowering the temperature?
sentences.zh: 是那种文明、团结和降低紧张局势的感觉吗？

sentences.en: Or will it be other things that he has promised, like justice, equality, and really leaning in to making the American promise apply to all?
sentences.zh: 还是他承诺过的其他事情，比如正义、平等，以及真正致力于让美国承诺适用于所有人？

sentences.en: How he can square those two things is not only something that folks will be skeptical about, but something that might make people doubt his commitment to one or the other.
sentences.zh: 他如何协调这两者，不仅是人们会持怀疑态度的，而且可能会让人们怀疑他对其中任何一个的承诺。

sentences.en: Right, which brings us to the question of what unity really means and looks like to Joe Biden, because he doesn't really define it in the speech.
sentences.zh: 没错，这就引出了一个问题，即对乔·拜登来说，团结到底意味着什么，看起来是什么样子的，因为他在演讲中并没有真正定义它。

sentences.en: Think about the ideology that was expressed by the people who stormed the Capitol, the explicit rejection of democracy, the open embrace of bigotry, the real comfort with violence,
sentences.zh: 想想那些冲击国会大厦的人所表达的意识形态，对民主的明确拒绝，对偏执的公开拥抱，对暴力的真正舒适感，

sentences.en: not only against police officers and lawmakers, the real sense that the communities that elected Joe Biden were not equal partners in democracy.
sentences.zh: 不仅是对警察和立法者，还有一种真正的感觉，即选举乔·拜登的社区在民主中不是平等的伙伴。

sentences.en: What does unity look like with those communities?
sentences.zh: 与这些社区的团结是什么样的？

sentences.en: What does unity look like with lawmakers who will not denounce them?
sentences.zh: 与那些不谴责他们的立法者的团结是什么样的？

sentences.en: How does Joe Biden move forward in terms of kind of creating this lower temperature that he talks about when the core tenets of what made something like this month's attack possible are opposed to America's founding principles?
sentences.zh: 当导致本月袭击事件的核心原则与美国的建国原则背道而驰时，乔·拜登如何在他所谈论的降低紧张局势方面取得进展？

sentences.en: So, I mean, it is in one hand, a clear political message, one that speaks to America's desire to see itself in the best possible light.
sentences.zh: 所以，我的意思是，一方面，这是一个明确的政治信息，一个迎合美国希望以最佳视角看待自己的愿望的信息。

sentences.en: But it is in another, a real flattening of our challenges and a real downplaying of the forces that have led to this moment.
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，这确实是对我们挑战的平淡化，也是对导致这一时刻的力量的淡化。

sentences.en: And so Joe Biden has achieved his first goal, which is to defeat Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 所以乔·拜登实现了他的第一个目标，那就是击败唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: If Joe Biden is going to achieve goals two and three and four, which were all about, you know, the kind of big isms and attacking those things,
sentences.zh: 如果乔·拜登要实现第二个、第三个和第四个目标，这些目标都是关于那些大的主义和攻击这些东西，

sentences.en: it might require abandoning that same rhetoric of unity and healing that got him to that point.
sentences.zh: 这可能需要放弃那种让他达到这一点的团结和治愈的修辞。

sentences.en: Something we suspect he would do very reluctantly, given his nature, given his history.
sentences.zh: 考虑到他的天性和历史，我们怀疑他会非常不情愿地这样做。

sentences.en: Yeah, you know, in his speech, he says, if we show a little tolerance and humility, and if we're willing to stand in the other person's shoes, who is he talking about?
sentences.zh: 是的，你知道，他在演讲中说，如果我们表现出一点宽容和谦逊，如果我们愿意站在别人的立场上，他在说谁？

sentences.en: Is he talking about standing in the shoes of folks who do not accept the right of certain people to participate in this democracy, who, you know,
sentences.zh: 他是在说要站在那些不接受某些人参与这个民主国家的权利的人的立场上吗，那些，你知道，

sentences.en: stormed the Capitol in the name of insurrection?
sentences.zh: 以叛乱的名义冲击国会大厦的人？

sentences.en: Or is he charging them with coming towards the kind of basic and core democratic principles?
sentences.zh: 还是他在要求他们向某种基本和核心的民主原则靠拢？

sentences.en: And so the question I have is, does the unity that Joe Biden seeks, is that with the folks who are attacking democracy?
sentences.zh: 所以我有的问题是，乔·拜登寻求的团结，是与那些攻击民主的人团结吗？

sentences.en: Or is he seeking to unite the rest of the country against those people?
sentences.zh: 还是他试图团结国家的其余部分来反对这些人？

sentences.en: And I think that speaks to how big do you think the challenges that Trump exposed are?
sentences.zh: 我认为这说明了你认为特朗普暴露出的挑战有多大？

sentences.en: How big do you think the scenes that we saw at the Capitol building and the attempts by members of Congress to challenge the election results?
sentences.zh: 你认为我们在国会大厦看到的场景以及国会议员挑战选举结果的尝试有多大？

sentences.en: How really core of a threat do you think that is to our democratic society?
sentences.zh: 你认为这对我们的民主社会来说是一个多么核心的威胁？

sentences.en: If you think that that is an existential threat, that is the challenge of our time, that that is a rallying point for people to stand up,
sentences.zh: 如果你认为这是一个生存威胁，是我们这个时代的挑战，是人们站起来的集结点，

sentences.en: then that requires a very specific and targeted effort to combat it.
sentences.zh: 那么这就需要一个非常具体和有针对性的努力来打击它。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But if you think it is a blip in the road, if you think that it is Trump specific, if you think that it will go away as Republicans have an epiphany, as Joe Biden has called it,
sentences.zh: 但如果你认为这只是路上的一个小插曲，如果你认为这是特朗普特有的，如果你认为正如乔·拜登所说，随着共和党人有了顿悟，它会消失，

sentences.en: six months down the line, then what this is, is him turning the page to allow that to happen.
sentences.zh: 六个月后，那么这就是他翻开新篇章以允许这种情况发生。

sentences.en: That when he sets the tone, when he speaks in new words, when he kind of charges Americans to be better, that that will be followed.
sentences.zh: 当他设定基调，当他用新的词汇说话，当他要求美国人变得更好时，那将会被遵循。

sentences.en: There is a lot of reason to be skeptical of that vision, but it is undeniable that that is what Joe Biden believes.
sentences.zh: 有很多理由对这种愿景持怀疑态度，但不可否认的是，这就是乔·拜登所相信的。

sentences.en: And that is what Joe Biden is charging the rest of us to believe.
sentences.zh: 而这就是乔·拜登要求我们其他人去相信的。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: It's just after six and I'm sitting in the Rotunda on Capitol Hill.
sentences.zh: 现在刚过六点，我正坐在国会山的圆形大厅里。

sentences.en: staff is already taking down the lighting the camera equipment all of the things that had been
sentences.zh: 工作人员已经在拆除灯光、摄像设备，所有那些为了就职典礼而临时设置在这里的东西，

sentences.en: temporarily set up here for inauguration the rotunda is my favorite place in this building
sentences.zh: 圆形大厅是我在这栋建筑里最喜欢的地方，

sentences.en: like it is for a lot of people not only does it physically represent a lot of our history and
sentences.zh: 就像很多人一样，它不仅在物理上代表了我们很多的历史和民主，

sentences.en: democracy with its massive paintings and statues and beautiful artwork but there's something about
sentences.zh: 有着巨大的画作、雕像和美丽的艺术品，而且当周围没有其他人时，当时间很晚因为你在等投票，

sentences.en: sitting here when no one else is around when it's really late because you're waiting for a vote or
sentences.zh: 或者你在蹲守一场会议，或者因为你在听证会前赶到这里而时间很早时，坐在这里有一种特别的感觉，

sentences.en: you're staking out a meeting or really early because you got there before a hearing there's
sentences.zh: 坐在这里有一种特别的感觉，对这个地方以及这个地方所代表的东西感到敬畏，

sentences.en: something really special about being here and being in awe of the place and what the place represents
sentences.zh: 坐在这里有一种特别的感觉，对这个地方以及这个地方所代表的东西感到敬畏，

sentences.en: and to think about one more moment in history that's just been jammed into a really stunning
sentences.zh: 想到这栋建筑在令人惊叹的两周里又被塞进了一个历史时刻，我看着拜登总统和哈里斯副总统今天早些时候走过的门，

sentences.en: two weeks in this building i'm looking at the door that president biden and vice president harris
sentences.zh: 门上有一块玻璃从1月6日开始就碎了，你可以看到玻璃上的蜘蛛网状裂纹，从我房间的对面看过去，

sentences.en: walked through earlier today there's a pain in the door that's still broken from january 6th you can see
sentences.zh: 我想我还在消化拜登总统和哈里斯副总统就职的画面将如何与我在1月6日看到的画面并列，

sentences.en: the spider cracks in the glass from where i am across the room i think i'm still processing how
sentences.zh: 就像把心理图像并排排列一样，但尽管还有很长的路要走，那块窗玻璃仍然破碎，

sentences.en: the images of president biden and vice president harris taking office will be juxtaposed with what i saw
sentences.zh: 关于发生的事情还有很多需要剖析，还有弹劾审判，参议院还需要达成权力分享协议，

sentences.en: on january 6th sort of lining the mental images side by side but even though there's a really long way
sentences.zh: 以及仍然存在的分歧，但今天很和平，我很感激这一点，我们马上回来。

sentences.en: to go that windowpane is still shattered there's so much to dissect about what happened there's still
sentences.zh: 这就是你今天还需要知道的事情，就职典礼后，拜登总统签署了一系列行政命令，涵盖从大流行到气候变化的所有内容，

sentences.en: an impeachment trial there's still a power sharing agreement that needs to be reached in the senate
sentences.zh: 然后在白宫阳台上与第一夫人吉尔·拜登博士进行了当天的最后一次公开露面，

sentences.en: and the division that still persists but today was peaceful and i'm grateful for that we'll be right
sentences.zh: 参议院提交了两份佐治亚州的选举证书，以及一份填补前加利福尼亚州参议员卡玛拉·D·哈里斯辞职后空缺的任命证书，

sentences.en: back here's what else you need to know today following the inauguration president biden signed a
sentences.zh: 民主党人周三正式宣布控制参议院，是的，那非常奇怪，好的，
